summary: frontend-orb preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs detects the host OS/arch, downloads a Bun runtime archive from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (v1.3.13), unpacks it to a temporary directory, marks the extracted `bun` binary executable, and uses it via execFileSync to run the sibling file math_init.js at npm install time. math_init.js is a 727KB `// @bun @bun-cjs` file whose contents are hidden behind a shuffled-string-array plus numeric-constant decoder (functions WV8StW, n7gIxM, hc1jfK9 with hex-named identifiers); the actual behavior is not resolvable without executing the decoder. Running the payload under a downloaded alternate runtime evades Node-based tooling and hands the fetched code full host-level execution during install. The package is advertised as a CircleCI orb (YAML under src/commands, src/jobs, src/executors, @orb.yml) and declares `main: index.js`, but no index.js is present in the tarball — the only install-time effect of this artifact is the Bun dropper + obfuscated payload pair, which does not correspond to any legitimate CircleCI orb functionality.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
